name: Tenneco Clean Air India Limited
summary: Tenneco Clean Air India Limited operates as a manufacturer and supplier of clean air and powertrain solutions. The company operates in two segments, clean air and powertrain solutions; and advanced ride technologies. The company designs, manufactures, and sells exhaust aftertreatment systems, such as catalytic converters, mufflers, and exhaust pipes; engine bearings, sealing systems, and ignition products, such as spark plugs and ignition coils; and shock absorbers, struts and dampers, suspension systems, and ride control technologies.
